label: Data Backup & Restore (data_backup)
type: a Server RBAC role granting bucket-level backup/restore access via cbbackupmgr, WITHOUT cluster-level administrative access - does not cover cluster-level data such as Analytics Synonyms (role:analytics-admin's domain). Filed under its internal name per this project's role-naming convention (display label in aliases).
aliases_note: Folds a same-round self-fork with a twist: round 12's own RBAC catalogue extraction (learn/security/roles.json) had already named this role as role:data-backup-and-restore (the display-label spelling) and left it unpromoted at 1 file since round 12. Round 19's two backup-restore batches then independently re-encountered it - one under the internal name (role:data-backup, 2 files), one under the display label again (role:data-backup-and-restore, 1 more file) - for a combined 4 files across three extraction events spanning two rounds, zero overlap. Filed under the internal name per the convention `roles.md`-derived ids have used since round 13.
evidence: Bucket level data may be backed up/restored using the `data_backup` (Data Backup & Restore) role.
The `data_backup` role does not have access to cluster level data such as: Analytics Synonyms
relates_to_competency_question: Does backing up a bucket require a cluster administrator, or is there a narrower role scoped to just that operation?
